# Security policy

Report a vulnerability privately through
[GitHub's private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/lipkau/lan-dhcp/security/advisories/new), not in a
public issue. You'll get an answer within a week.

Only the newest release gets fixes. A flaw in dnsmasq itself belongs upstream, on the
[dnsmasq mailing list](https://thekelleys.org.uk/dnsmasq/doc.html). Once a fixed dnsmasq release is out, this
repository ships it in a new release.
